news.headline: Bavarian Nordic names new CEO; Abivax and ProQR add key leaders
JMP Securities raises Abivax price target to $114 from $95
news.summary: JMP Securities (Citizens JMP) raised its Abivax price target to $114 from $95 while maintaining a Market Outperform rating, updating its model for the H1 2026 results and the July ADS financing.

news.headline: Barclays Reaffirms Overweight Rating for Abivax, $148 Price Target
news.summary: Barclays reissued an Overweight rating on Abivax with a $148 price target on Sept 22, 2026, implying meaningful upside from the post-earnings share price. The reaffirmation came in the same week most sell-side firms stayed bullish despite a wider-than-expected H1 net loss.

news.headline: Sell-Side Analysts Trim Price Targets on Abivax After Wider-Than-Expected H1 Loss
news.summary: Following Abivax's Sept 21 H1 2026 report showing a wider-than-expected per-share loss, Wedbush's David Nierengarten cut his price target to $118 from $140 (Neutral) while Truist's Gregory Renza trimmed his target to $151 from $155 (Buy). Shares gave back ground even as most analysts kept a constructive view on obefazimod's regulatory and commercial trajectory.

news.headline: Abivax Presents Business Updates and First Half 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Abivax reported €402.4 million in cash at June 30, 2026, projecting a runway into Q4 2029 after its July ADS offering; H1 net loss widened to €165.9 million on R&D spend of €107.9 million. The company reaffirmed it remains on track to submit the obefazimod NDA to the FDA for ulcerative colitis by end-2026, announced CMO Fabio Cataldi's departure (succeeded by Chris Rabbat) alongside new CTO Tim Kelly, and said it will present further obefazimod data at UEGW in October 2026.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Coverage on Abivax With Buy Rating, $155 Price Target
news.summary: Goldman Sachs analyst Rajan Sharma started coverage of Abivax with a Buy rating and a $155 price target, calling obefazimod's Phase 3 ABTECT efficacy and maintenance data "biologic-like" in an oral pill and modeling peak sales of roughly €4 billion in ulcerative colitis.

news.headline: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.source: STAT News (Adam's Biotech Scorecard, Adam Feuerstein)
news.summary: Nine months after speculation first pegged a roughly $20 billion buyout of Abivax as imminent, STAT News noted the deal still had not materialized despite red-hot biotech M&A activity, framing Abivax's continued independence as a source of growing investor frustration even as obefazimod's commercial potential remains widely viewed as attractive to acquirers.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod NDA submission to FDA (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA FDA interaction (July 30, 2026), Abivax reaffirmed at its Sept 21, 2026 H1 report that it remains on track to submit the NDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026. Not yet submitted as of Sept 26, 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA marketing authorization filing (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for filing obefazimod for EMA approval in ulcerative colitis in the second half of 2026, alongside the FDA NDA submission.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod data presentation at UEGW
catalysts.detail: Abivax confirmed at its Sept 21, 2026 H1 report that it will present additional obefazimod clinical data at United European Gastroenterology Week (UEGW) in October 2026. Not yet occurred as of Sept 26, 2026.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b induction readout (Crohn's disease)
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction data from the ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b trial of obefazimod in Crohn's disease has slipped to mid-2027 per the latest pipeline guidance, reaffirmed at the Sept 21, 2026 H1 report.

catalysts.label: CMO transition to Chris Rabbat
catalysts.detail: Current Chief Medical Officer Fabio Cataldi will depart in Q4 2026 and be succeeded by Chris Rabbat, alongside newly appointed CTO Tim Kelly, as the company builds out commercial/CMC leadership ahead of a potential launch.

catalysts.label: Potential acquisition by Big Pharma (Eli Lilly / AstraZeneca)
catalysts.detail: Recurring 2026 media reports linked Abivax to takeover interest from Eli Lilly (~€15bn, January 2026) and AstraZeneca (March 2026); both companies have declined to confirm or denied talks. As of Sept 3, 2026 (STAT News) and through Sept 26, 2026, no deal has materialized, with management continuing to emphasize a standalone U.S. launch strategy instead.

pulse: Abivax's Sept 21, 2026 H1 report reaffirmed that the obefazimod NDA for ulcerative colitis remains on track for filing by end-2026 (with a parallel EMA filing guided for H2 2026) and that additional Phase 3 data will be shown at UEGW in October, but a wider-than-expected net loss (€165.9M) prompted Wedbush and Truist to trim price targets even as Barclays reaffirmed Overweight ($148 PT), JMP Securities raised its target to $114 on Sept 25, and the broader sell-side consensus stays Strong Buy following Goldman Sachs' Buy initiation ($155 PT) earlier in September. The Crohn's-disease ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b readout has slipped to mid-2027, and CMO Fabio Cataldi is set to hand off to Chris Rabbat in Q4 2026. The long-running Eli Lilly/AstraZeneca takeover speculation remains unresolved per STAT News, with management continuing to build out an independent U.S. commercial launch instead; neither the NDA filing nor the UEGW data readout has occurred yet as of Sept 26, 2026.
